title: How Many Ants Are on Earth?
lines: How many ants are there on Earth?
Start with one colony: | a few thousand ants, under a single stone.
In {2022~twenty twenty-two}, scientists combined nearly five hundred ground surveys | from every continent but Antarctica.
Their conservative estimate: | twenty quadrillion ants.
That's a two, followed by sixteen zeros.
Nearly two and a half million ants | for every person alive.
Together, they outweigh all the wild birds and wild mammals on Earth, | combined.
And they've been here for over a hundred million years, | since the age of the dinosaurs.
Now line them all up, | end to end, at half a centimeter each.
The line leaves Earth, | passes Neptune, | then Pluto.
It would stretch about six hundred and seventy times the distance from Earth to the Sun.
Look down. | You're never really alone.
Be honest: | when you find an ant in your kitchen, | do you let it live? | Tell me in the comments.

preroll.line: Line up every ant on Earth, | and the line reaches far past Pluto.
